genericProblem: An implementation-facing design can inherit accepted UI declarations yet restate them with non-export names, omit their lower-bound primitives, omit supporting shell chrome, or phrase a negative discriminator as a legal business path. The resulting future gate can be mechanically green while either impossible to execute or aimed at the wrong behavior.
finiteDenominator: all physical-screen and roster foundation primitive occurrences
all non-catalog screen contracts and U01 frontend change surfaces
all roster concrete final-consumer path claims
searchQueries: Use a REGION assignment to manage PROJECT users
counterexamples: The IA sources already use only actual foundation exports; the naming regression begins in the implementation-facing roster/contracts.
A REGION assignment can legally manage a PROJECT below that same REGION; only a peer-region target is rejected by ancestor containment.
The carry-over surface ledger intentionally has 22 surfaces and no PLATFORM-SHELL; platform shell chrome therefore needs a supporting-screen contract rather than an invented 23rd catalog surface.
U01 has no UI implementation authority, so its frontend declarations must be limited to generated consumer output rather than whole app source roots.

findings.genericProblem: Foundation contract names can be module basenames rather than exports.
findings.evidence: index.ts exports useOverlayLock and createObservedBaseQuery, while the P6 roster/contracts used their module basenames.

findings.genericProblem: A physical screen contract can silently drop an accepted IA primitive.
findings.evidence: IA and physical screen rows disagree for login, Drawers and result Modals.

findings.genericProblem: A supporting app shell absent from the catalog denominator can be omitted from implementation proof.
findings.evidence: IA02 defines platform authenticated shell; the 22-surface ledger has no platform-shell surface.

findings.genericProblem: A no-UI delivery phase can name a root wide enough to admit feature UI.
findings.evidence: U01 named whole app src while only generated consumers are allowed.

findings.genericProblem: A negative discriminator can misstate an allowed owner relation.
findings.evidence: admin catalog and OrganizationTaskPathService allow same-region project management by ancestor containment.

findings.genericProblem: Concrete path/count prose can drift from the physical contract and frozen manifest.
findings.evidence: generic recovery filenames and four-versus-five non-catalog prose disagreed with physical contracts/manifest.

authorizationBoundary: Static implementation-facing design and evidence only; no implementation, contract/source/test modification, dynamic execution, DEV, seed/reset, Roadmap state or repository-control action.
